blocks.text: Now see, reader, a remarkable metamorphosis of the hoopoe into a lark, whose author is the Pandectarius: Alauda [lark], he says, is in Arabic the bird hoopoe. On the contrary, alauda in Arabic is a meaningless word. But he made alauda out of alhudhud. Thus Aelian observes, History book 16, chapter 5, that the Athenians tell of the lark the same story that the Brahmins tell of the hoopoe.
